gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
Who is going to deal ___ the angry customer?
gaps.explanation: deal with = handle; deal in = trade.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).
